LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 9.3.1 WORD CLASSES: CONJUNCTIONS – BECAUSE, THAT, WHEN, IF, UNLESS, AND SINCE

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENT
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.3: Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unless, and since
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unless, and since, part of Strand 9 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8 ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH PHYSICAL IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: when, if, unless, and since from the text individualy, 1. Why should we join sentences correctly? 2. Why do we use conjunctions?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify the listed conjunctions from a group of words,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unless, and since in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. use the listed conjunctions correctly in sentences,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unless, and since in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. appreciate the correct use of conjunctions in communication. • Work with peers to read a text, Learners who may not turn pages to use page turners or be supported by peers. • Identify conjunctions such as because, that, when, if, unless, and since from the text individualy, 1. Why should we join sentences correctly? 2. Why do we use conjunctions? 3. How can one join two or more sentences? 80 • Fill in blanks in sentences using the listed conjunctions individually, Learners with manipulation difficulties could use adapted writing materials or type on appropriate adapted digital devices to fill the blanks on a given template. • Make sentences using the listed conjunctions, • Collaborate to create dialogues using the listed conjunctions, • Search online and offline for examples of the listed conjunctions, Control light intensity for learners who are sensitive to light while using the digital devices. • Create crossword puzzles and code words featuring conjunctions, • Create posters on heroes/heroines using sentences with conjunctions and display them on the walls, 81 • Search for sentences with conjunctions from the internet, • Recite poems featuring conjunctions/ listen to songs and identify the conjunctions used. Allow more time for learners with speech difficulties.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in use 9.3.1 Word Classes: Conjunctions – because, that, when, if, unless, and since together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Collaboration and team work is enhanced as the learners recite poems with peers.

• Creativity and imagination is developed as learners make connections and create posters on heroes or heroines.

Values:
Patriotism is promoted as learners create posters of African heroes and heroines and this makes learners proud of their nation

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Citizenship – good governance is promoted as some African heroes and heroines stories address issues of governance

Link to other subjects:

The concepts of creating posters is related to the strand of creating in Creative Arts.
